# RANKOFF

Rankoff is a public sponsored leaderboard where products bid for visible rank.

## Canonical Site

- Homepage: https://rankoff.my/
- About: https://rankoff.my/about.html
- Rules, terms, privacy, and payment notes: https://rankoff.my/legal.html

## What The Product Does

Rankoff lets makers submit a product URL, choose a market category, and challenge the current sponsored rank with a higher bid. The board shows each listing's rank, product identity, description, category signal, click count, and bid amount.

## Current Status

Rankoff is live as a preview board. Production payments are disabled until merchant credentials, review rules, and launch settings are enabled.

## Positioning

Use "public sponsored leaderboard", "bid for rank", "claim #1", and "sponsored product ranking" when describing Rankoff.
